I4.observedNetworkCaveat: Historical platform subnet placement used public IP and IGW. T3 sets public IP DISABLED. Obtain route tables, endpoint policies, egress/ingress, VPC relation, DNS and TLS proof before binding the launch placement.

costInputs: Fargate vCPU and memory billed from image pull through termination
Network egress or endpoint/NAT charges if required

historicalComputeOnlyExample.scope: Illustration at candidate sizing using historical published rates. Excludes network, logs and retained resources. Refresh before approval.

I5.lifetimeVerification: Prove the wall-clock cutoff for startup and running work, with separate observation of a task stuck in provisioning or image pull. ECS container StopTimeout is a stop grace period. Any explicit StopTask access or invocation needs exact review.
I5.rollback: Before any execution compare exact stopped Original and physical resources with the Change Set. On missing acknowledgement or drift stop and read back the exact change. After independently confirming the result, any rollback restores the reviewed stopped template and old task definition only under its own authorization. Never automatically restore ALB, DNS, databases or Web service.

pendingReadOnlyScope.purpose: Bind the stopped Original, retained physical IDs and potential private route topology. Return redacted metadata only.

stopOn: Wrong account, region or resource owner
Results require pagination or exceed the reviewed scope
Different stopped state or pending change set
A needed fact requires a secret value, DB connection or write
outOfScope: Resource start/restore, policy writes, change sets, or task runs
